column1: # Labels for CHK002 (unused dependency) / CHK003 (missing dependency) findings
# on the §17 OSS validation set. `fp`/`tp` are ground truth; `deferred` records
# heuristic triage that still needs validation.
# Tab-separated columns (lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored):
#   target        stable JSON target field (was distribution for dep rules)
#   bucket        root-cause bucket for CHK003 fp or deferred; use - otherwise
#   note          short justification (how it was verified)
# Bucket vocabulary (CHK003 fp/deferred): map-gap | workspace-boundary | optional-import |
# scripts/oss-metrics.sh matches findings on (slug, code, target).
# Unlabeled findings are unknown; unknown and deferred block CHK002 FP gate.
